verdict.rationale: Angular's first-party docs describe built-in Signals for fine-grained reactive state updates and first-party dependency injection, which together imply app-wide shared state without a third-party library. The evidence never explicitly addresses global or app-wide state management, so delivery of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit docs on global or shared state patterns (e.g., signal-based services provided at root), guidance on when an external store is unnecessary, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
